text:
incident-bot: Pager: metering.analyzer detected token-count drift for ingestion pipeline 'meter-v2' — sudden +18% delta vs baseline in last 10m. Auto-throttle not yet triggered. Paging #oncall-sre :rotating_light:

maya: seeing same in dashboards. per-route token delta spiking for a subset of customers, also some overage flags firing in billing-alerts.

lee: confirming — metrics: token_count_emitted 1.18x expected, emitter-lag up ~30s. starting quick triage.

sasha: @billing-ops any customers alerted yet? support queue showing 3 tickets about overage emails in last 7m.

billing-ops: we got 4 automated overage notifications queued; paused outbound emails and suppressed billing jobs at 3165432137. holding until we confirm root cause.

jordan: timeline: 3165432100 root detect; 3165432137 billing suppression. Good call.

maya: initial hypothesis — duplicate counting after consumer ack replay on the aggregator. we saw a backlog replay spike earlier at 3165432000 when batch replays resumed.

lee: running targeted query on aggregator offsets now. command:```sql
SELECT pipeline, count, window_start, window_end
FROM metering.agg
WHERE window_start >= '2026-03-15T10:50:00Z'
AND pipeline = 'meter-v2'
ORDER BY window_start DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

sasha: logs show repeated re-ingest of same request ids from the staging shard (shard-7) during a transient SQS visibility timeout bump. snippet:```
[3165432122] shard-7: ingest id=abc123 recv=1 replay=1
[3165432123] shard-7: ingest id=abc123 recv=2 replay=2
[3165432123] shard-7: emit tokens=512 id=abc123
```

oncall-sre: mitigation options: 1) pause aggregator replay (fast, partial) 2) switch to backup dedupe path (safer) 3) enforce short-term per-customer hard cap to stop overage alerts.

maya: doing (1) now — disabling replay consumer for shard-7. `kubectl scale deployment replay-consumer-shard-7 --replicas=0` -> executed at 3165432184.

lee: started on (2) in parallel: enabling dedupe-modes via config toggle in configstore -> `metering.dedupe.enabled=true` and rolling aggregator. rolling patch applied at 3165432201.

sasha: thanks. billing-ops — any customers already billed or charged?

billing-ops: no invoices posted yet. A small set of warning emails were queued but not sent; we suppressed at 3165432137. we'll run a manual reconciliation after counts stabilize, and will NOT charge until reconciliation completes.

support-lead: we should prepare a short message for affected customers: "We're investigating anomalous usage reports and will reverse any erroneous overage notifications. No charges will be posted while we reconcile." drafting now.

jordan: monitoring: token delta down from +18% -> +2% within 6m after toggles. emitter lag back to normal.

maya: confirm replay paused + dedupe enabled. applying safety guard: set per-customer temp cap to 2x baseline to prevent spike-induced overage: `metering.temp_cap.multiplier=2` at 3165432258.

incident-bot: Incident status update: INVESTIGATING -> MITIGATING. Incident priority: P2. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-count-drift (actioned steps 1-3).

lee: added temporary metric alert to watch for double-emits: `alert double_emit_rate > 0.5% for 2m` — linked to #pagerduty.

sasha: starting a background job to re-run usage reconciliation for affected window 2026-03-15T10:40Z-10:55Z. estimate ~20m to finish. kicked off at 3165432290.

billing-ops: once reconciliation finishes, we'll create a revert batch for any erroneous usage and coordinate crediting. sending note to Finance & Revenue ops.

support-lead: queued a customer-facing status update to be posted in-app and via the status page after we confirm impact. will wait for billing-ops go-ahead.

maya: postmortem notes in progress. suspected root cause: SQS visibility timeout regression causing duplicate delivery + missing dedupe in aggregator for shard-7 after a config rollout.

jordan: ETA: finish reconciliation + confirm no invoices -> 3165432500.

incident-bot: Update: reconciliation job complete at 3165432487. Results: net token delta for window corrected to +0.3% after dedupe, 0 customers charged erroneously. 9 customers received warning emails (suppressed) — support outreach required.

billing-ops: we verified no invoices posted; queued credits not needed. we'll run a full-run of billing audit tomorrow morning.

support-lead: sending customer note now. short text: "We detected incorrect usage spikes that triggered warning emails. No charges were applied. We're reversing the warnings and will follow up if you have questions."

maya: marking incident as mitigated. root cause label: SQS visibility regression + missing dedupe fallback. follow-ups: improve replay safety checks, add integration test for duplicate-id handling, and add delayed-batch reconciliation to nightly job.

lee: assigning follow-up tickets: SRE-1023 (add integration test), METER-588 (dedupe config hardening), SUPPORT-404 (customer outreach checklist).

jordan: great work all. Retrospective to be scheduled tomorrow. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
